key_idea: Replace the infinite-dimensional partition optimization with a finite-dimensional maximization over Gaussian linear scores, and use covariance bounds and rearrangement inequalities to exclude configurations with five or more cells.
reason: The proof establishes a strong conceptual architecture by translating partition optimality into geometric constraints on score vectors. However, resolving the remaining high-dimensional cases requires a chain of technical estimates and finite numerical enclosures, which somewhat dilutes its structural simplicity and transparency.
recognized: Proof of the Khot-Naor Gaussian Propeller conjecture
